fusions.name: Warning Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps at the target from behind the shield, which deals 4 damage and leaves it 4% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Call the Pack
fusions.desc: Barks from behind the shield in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hackles Up
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A guard hound fights beside you for 8 seconds, biting for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shared Spoils
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
